description: An open-source AI-driven bio-design toolkit, derived from leaked research frameworks and trained on public genomic databases, is discovered being used by a network of amateur biologists in three member states to engineer novel bacteriophages targeting antibiotic-resistant bacteria. While the designs are not yet weaponized, several bypass existing EU screening protocols, triggering alarm in biosecurity agencies. The episode reveals a growing 'bio-hacker' ecosystem operating outside institutional oversight, enabled by accessible AI and garage-scale lab tech.
